name: ogonyok
description: Telegram bot + mini app: привычки, серии и занятия, на Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.secrets: wrangler secret put BOT_TOKEN && wrangler secret put WEBHOOK_SECRET
scripts.dev:curated: npm run build && wrangler dev --env curated
scripts.deploy:curated: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env curated
scripts.db:migrate:curated: wrangler d1 migrations apply tracker-curated --env curated --remote
scripts.db:migrate:curated:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply tracker-curated --env curated --local
scripts.secrets:curated: wrangler secret put BOT_TOKEN --env curated && wrangler secret put WEBHOOK_SECRET --env curated
